name: Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) — 5 U.S.C. §552
notes: Establishes the public's right to access federal agency records, with enumerated exemptions. CUI marking interacts with FOIA exemptions.

derives_from.note: Necessary and Proper Clause — Congress's authority to enact laws structuring Executive Branch information-disclosure obligations, supplementing its plenary power over federal agency administration.
